subject: Post-demo: deployment choice & hosted quickstart roadmap
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-07T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo recap & next steps — deployment options and quickstart

Thanks again for taking the demo today — appreciate you and Tom for the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary of what we heard
- Primary goal: integrate real-time summarization + sentiment signals into FinLytics' customer success console (latency SLO: <=250ms p50 for single-turn summaries).
- Data residency: US-only for PII; SOC 2 required for pilot.
- Expected pilot traffic: 5k monthly conversations, spikes up to ~2k concurrent short requests during enterprise syncs.

Options we discussed
1) Hosted API: fastest on-ramp, our managed endpoints, streaming or sync, prefix KV caching for session-based summaries. Good if you want zero infra ops and quick iteration.
2) Dedicated: reserved GPU pool — lower per-token cost at sustained throughput, predictable latency at scale.
3) Private VPC/on-prem: required only if you need full network isolation or on-prem compute.

Proposed quickstart deliverables (attached):
- Pilot MVP plan (attached): endpoints, sample payloads, test keys
- Hosted ratecaps reference CSV (attached): limits we can provision for a trial
- SOC2 summary (attached): audit evidence we can supply for pilot

Immediate ask / next steps
- Sam: confirm preferred path (Hosted vs Dedicated) for pilot by EOD Friday 6/11. If Hosted, tell us whether streaming or non-streaming endpoint preferred.
- Aditya/Marissa: propose a 2-week sandbox window and test key config once Sam confirms.

If useful, I can sync with your security contact to walk through the SOC 2 artifacts next week.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
https://redwoodinference.com

Date: 2026-06-08T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — deployment options and quickstart

Thanks Irene — useful recap. Quick answers from our side:

- We think Hosted API looks like the right starting point for the pilot to move fastest.
- Streaming would be preferable for the long-running session summaries (lower perceived latency), but we can start with sync endpoints if that's easier for the sandbox.
- Security contact: cc'ing our InfoSec lead Tom (tom@brickpay.com) — he may ask for more detailed audit artifacts.

Two follow-ups:
1) Can you confirm typical p95 latency on your hosted streaming endpoint for payloads ~1.5k tokens?
2) Can we get a temporary increase on ratecaps for the sandbox to hit simulated spike staging?

Sam
Sam Park
Head of Product | FinLytics
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam@finlytics.ai>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-06-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap & next steps — deployment options and quickstart

Great to hear Hosted is the preferred path. Answering Sam's two questions below and adding a couple ops notes: 

Latency and performance
- For streaming with payloads ~1.5k tokens we typically see p50 ~120-160ms and p95 ~380-520ms on our hosted endpoints (varies by model choice; numbers above are for our optimized open model with moderate quantization).
- If you need strict p95 <=250ms we recommend either a dedicated pool + smaller model selection or restricting sequence length + enabling prefix KV cache for repeated session context. Happy to run a short benchmark with a representative request to give precise numbers.

Ratecaps and sandbox increases
- We can provision sandbox ratecaps up to 500 rps for a 2-week window (subject to TOS). I've attached the reference CSV with baseline and burst tiers. To increase beyond that for stress tests we can open a short request with infra ops; please confirm target rps and spike profile (sustained vs short bursts).

Ops checklist for Hosted pilot (suggested)
- Provide a sample payload (anonymized) and one representative conversational session for a benchmark run.
- Decide streaming vs sync for MVP (you said streaming preferred).
- Security: we'll share the SOC2 artifacts and Remediation Report with Tom.
- Post-benchmark we'll propose either: keep Hosted with tuned model/kv-cache, or move to Dedicated if sustained p95 SLA required.

Next steps
- Sam: drop the sample payload to the Drive link and confirm desired spike profile by EOD Friday 6/11.
- Tom: if you'd like a separate walkthrough of the SOC 2 artifacts, propose times and we’ll coordinate.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

If those are fine, we can sign the pilot terms and begin the sandbox next week.
